svg.title: One reproduction number, two transmission routes
svg.desc: New infections per day per thousand hosts in a susceptible-infectious-reservoir model with basic reproduction number 2.5 and a five-day infectious period, for three splits of transmission between direct contact and a shared environmental reservoir. Panel a: a slowly decaying reservoir (decay 0.05 per day) gives three distinct curves, later and lower as the reservoir share rises. Panel b: a fast reservoir (decay 5 per day) gives curves that coincide, so case counts alone cannot separate the routes. Assumed parameters; no inference is performed.
svg.title: One reproduction number, two transmission routes
